item.title: DoorDash driver hails key Trump policy after delivering McDonald's to White House: 'I'm going to enjoy it'
item.summary: DoorDash driver Sharron Simmons says she hopes Trump's no-tax-on-tips benefit in the One Big Beautiful Bill extends beyond its current 2028 expiration.

item.title: Swalwell announces resignation from Congress after sexual misconduct allegations torpedoed gubernatorial bid
item.summary: Rep. Eric Swalwell announced his resignation from Congress following a bombshell Chronicle report and the collapse of his California governor campaign.

item.title: Trump’s McDonald’s order comes with cash surprise for ‘DoorDash Grandma’ outside White House
item.summary: President Trump received a McDonald's delivery from a DoorDash driver in the Oval Office and tipped her $100 while promoting his no tax on tips policy.

item.title: JD Vance says the ball is 'in Iran’s court' after Pakistan peace talks stall
item.summary: VP JD Vance rejects reports Pakistan talks failed, says Iran negotiations made progress but Iranian team was unable to finalize a deal in talks.

item.title: Sydney Sweeney’s ‘Euphoria’ return sparks backlash as fans slam ‘humiliating’ storyline
item.summary: Viewers denounce "Euphoria's" creative direction after season three opener, saying Sydney Sweeney's provocative scenes as Cassie Howard are humiliating.

item.title: Sunny Hostin doesn't know if president is the 'right position' for Harris, urges her to reconsider CA governor
item.summary: "The View" co-host Sunny Hostin said she wanted Kamala Harris to reconsider running for California governor, though co-host Ana Navarro noted the deadline passed for entering the race.

item.title: Embattled Rep Tony Gonzales announces plans to resign amid sexual misconduct allegations
item.summary: Rep. Tony Gonzales, R-Texas, will resign from Congress after facing sexual misconduct allegations.

item.title: WATCH: Rowdy teenagers swarm DC Navy Yard in waterfront takeover despite police juvenile curfew zone
item.summary: D.C.'s Navy Yard saw another teen takeover this weekend, prompting a juvenile curfew zone and increased police presence to address ongoing disruptions.

item.title: Popular airline rolls out free bag perk for certain travelers — but there's a catch
item.summary: Southwest Airlines announced Sip and Ship, a new perk allowing customers to check one case of wine for free on flights to select West Coast airports.

item.title: Gabbard claims ‘coordinated effort’ by intelligence community to advance narrative to impeach Trump
item.summary: DNI Tulsi Gabbard releases declassified testimony she says exposes a coordinated effort to manufacture a narrative behind Trump's first impeachment.
